For the Laplace mechanism, if we add Laplace noise with parameter $b$ to a function $f$, then the mechanism satisfies $\varepsilon$-differential privacy if and only if $b \geq \frac{\Delta f}{\varepsilon}$, where $\Delta f$ is the global sensitivity of $f$.
